detail.title: WAKE Architectural Foundations: Governance and Receipt Layering
detail.summary: The governance module serves as the mechanical rulebook for WAKE, enforcing deterministic state transitions. Integration of receipt-based validation ensures that only atomic, schema-compliant transitions are committed, preventing partial or invalid state updates in the durable record.
